headline: Four in five UK hospitality firms report cost inflation restricting investment
summary: According to industry survey data, 80% of UK hospitality businesses report that rising energy and food costs are holding back capital investment despite stronger summer sales.
why: Hospitality accounts for a substantial share of UK employment and service sector economic activity.

impacts.name: UK Hospitality Sector
impacts.why: Sustained input inflation squeezes business margins and reduces capital expansion.
